acceptable_paraphrases: The diagram shows one circle with 2 tangent and a diameter
This circle has a radius of 2cm
4 cm is the diameter of the circle
critical_errors: mentioning circumference instead of radius or diameter
misconceptions: mentioning circumference without specifying radius or diameter
stating the circle has a half-diameter of 2 cm (indicating confusion about radius vs. diameter)
incorrectly stating the distance between tangents is the same as the radius
saying the distance between lines is 4 cm instead of 2 cm
grading_notes: Correct answers should include both tangents, specify the circle's radius or diameter (or use correct terminology), and indicate that the diagram shows a circle with two parallel tangent lines. Incorrectly stating the distance between lines as 4 cm would be considered a critical error.
